content.short: Cobra is a fast and convenient smart contract development and deployment framework for EVM blockchains.
content.description: Cobra provides a fast, intuitive development environment for smart contracts, built to be quick and highly adaptable. It supports efficient testing and deployment of Ethereum-based contracts to any EVM-compatible network. The framework delivers robust compilation, plus tooling for linking, binary management, and automated contract testing, and enables deployment to private networks and public networks, including local test runners and hosted node services, helping developers iterate rapidly from development to production.
